name: FFXI-EventsDump
description: FFXI Event Bytecode Parser and Analyzer. Parses, analyzes, and renders human-readable output from Final Fantasy XI event bytecode (DAT files). Includes a full opcode registry (225+ opcodes), control flow analysis using networkx, string formatting with parameter substitution, entity/zone data models, and Jinja2 template-based output generation. Based on atom0s/XiEvents and Windower/POLUtils research.
